tool_schemas.name: create-bookmark
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new bookmark (raindrop) in the specified internal collection for the given linked Raindrop account and returns the created bookmark record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id/collection_id do not match required formats, if url is missing/empty, or if any unknown fields are provided; raises NOT_FOUND if the account is not linked or the collection_id does not exist under that account; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to write to the account; raises CONFLICT if the bookmark cannot be created in the target collection due to the collection’s lifecycle state or a duplicate constraint enforced by the integration.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Raindrop account that will own the bookmark.

collection_id.description: Internal collection ID to create the bookmark in.

url.description: URL to save as a Raindrop bookmark.

tags.description: Optional list of tags to apply to the bookmark.

cover_url.description: Optional cover image URL for the bookmark.

tool_schemas.name: search-bookmarks
tool_schemas.description: Searches bookmarks for a linked Raindrop account using a free-text query against indexed bookmark content, optionally restricted to a single collection, and returns a page of results plus a cursor for the next page when more results are available. Results are paged with limit and cursor (omit cursor to fetch the first page); sort and order control result ordering when supported for the chosen executed_via. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or enum values are not allowed; raises NOT_FOUND if the account is not linked or collection_id is provided but does not belong to the account; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to search the account; raises CONFLICT when executed_via requests a mode that cannot be satisfied for the account’s current sync/index state.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Raindrop account to search within.

query.description: Free-text query to search against indexed bookmark content.

collection_id.description: Optional internal collection ID to restrict search results.

executed_via.description: Where to execute the search (remote Raindrop, local index, or hybrid).

limit.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: list-collections
tool_schemas.description: Lists collections (folders) for a linked Raindrop account and returns a paged collection list filtered by status and ordered by the requested sort and order. Results are paged with limit and cursor (omit cursor to fetch the first page) and the response includes a next cursor when additional collections remain. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if account_id is invalid, limit is out of range, cursor is malformed, or status/sort/order are not allowed; raises NOT_FOUND if the account is not linked; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view the account’s collections.

account_id.description: ID of the linked Raindrop account whose collections will be listed.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of collections.

tool_schemas.name: get-me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and integration entitlements for the current credential, including scopes and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the presented credential is missing/invalid or does not map to an active account + active api_credentials; may refuse with FORBIDDEN if the caller is not entitled to use the Raindrop integration.

authorization.description: Bearer access token presented to this backend (e.g., "Bearer <token>").

tool_schemas.name: create-account
tool_schemas.description: Links a Raindrop.io user to this integration by exchanging a Raindrop OAuth grant for an active account and active api_credentials record, then returns the created account. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are malformed or unknown fields are provided; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the OAuth exchange fails; refuses with CONFLICT if the Raindrop user is already linked and active.

authorization.description: Bearer access token presented to this backend (e.g., "Bearer <token>").

auth_type.description: Authentication method used to link the account.

oauth_code.description: OAuth authorization code returned by Raindrop.io.

redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI used for the OAuth authorization request (must match the original request).

state.description: Optional OAuth state value for CSRF protection/verification.

tool_schemas.name: get-account
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a linked account by id and returns the account record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if id is malformed; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authorized for the account or if the account is not active or lacks an active credential.

authorization.description: Bearer access token presented to this backend (e.g., "Bearer <token>").

account_id.description: ID of the linked Raindrop account to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: update-account
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an account and/or drives allowed lifecycle transitions on accounts.status (active->error/revoked, error->active/revoked). Returns the updated account. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if attempting an illegal status transition or unknown fields are provided; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authorized for the account or if there is no active credential when required for the requested change.

authorization.description: Bearer access token presented to this backend (e.g., "Bearer <token>").

account_id.description: ID of the linked Raindrop account to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the account (must be a valid transition from the current status).

display_name.description: Optional display name override stored by the integration.

email.description: Optional email override stored by the integration.

tool_schemas.name: get-bookmark
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single bookmark by id for a linked Raindrop account and returns the bookmark record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the bookmark does not exist under the account; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not active or lacks an active credential. Bookmarks with status='deleted' are not returned.

authorization.description: Bearer access token presented to this backend (e.g., "Bearer <token>").

account_id.description: ID of the linked Raindrop account that owns the bookmark.

tool_schemas.name: update-bookmark
tool_schemas.description: Updates a bookmark and/or drives allowed lifecycle transitions on bookmarks.status (draft->creating/deleted, creating->deleted, active->deleted, error->creating/deleted). Returns the updated bookmark record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, unknown fields, illegal status transitions, empty url, url exceeding maximum length, or too many tags; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the bookmark does not exist under the account; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the account is not active or lacks an active credential. If status is set to 'creating', the service may attempt (or re-attempt) remote creation in Raindrop.io and update raindrop_id/status accordingly.

authorization.description: Bearer access token presented to this backend (e.g., "Bearer <token>").

account_id.description: ID of the linked Raindrop account that owns the bookmark.

collection_id.description: Optional internal collection ID to move the bookmark to (must belong to the same account).

url.description: Updated URL for the bookmark (must be non-empty and within the service maximum length).

tags.description: Updated list of tags (must not exceed the service maximum count).

status.description: New lifecycle status for the bookmark (must be a valid transition from the current status).

metadata.name: Raindrop.io Integration
metadata.description: This backend stores user-linked Raindrop.io data needed by the integration: collections (folders), bookmarks (raindrops), and API/auth metadata for calling Raindrop.io on a user's behalf.
